186.name: Smelt Copper
186.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of copper ore into a copper bar. Smelting copper requires a forge.

186.description: Allows the miner to smelt chunks of dark iron ore into a dark iron bar. Smelting Dark Iron can only be done at the Black Forge in Blackrock Depths.

186.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of truesilver ore into a truesilver bar. Smelting truesilver requires a forge.

186.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of thorium ore into a thorium bar. Smelting thorium requires a forge.
